unsupported_modes: Automatic translation, graded course recommendations or unrestricted child suitability
Old deprecated APIv0 or unstable API for runtime use
query.paging: Follow returned same-origin next URL and after cursor. Subsequent pages can omit total. Do not synthesize page=n.
query.response_identity: Integer sentence ID, ISO639-3 language, nullable script, text, owner attribution, license and is_unapproved flag; no API revision date returned.

capabilities: Stable documented sentence keyword/language API and native sentence lookup; not a complete language course.
licensing: Text per native sentence license, typically CC BY2.0FR; some CC0. Audio licenses differ and may forbid external reuse.

identity_and_duplicates.summary: Tatoeba Association is a nonprofit association registered in France; one community sentence corpus with stable native IDs and mutable content.

facts.identity: Native integer sentence ID plus language/text/license/owner and observed response hash; no immutable edition or API modified timestamp.
facts.deduplication: Translations are separate linked sentence records of the same origin. Language variants, downstream Tatoeba datasets and mirrors do not increase independent-source counts.
facts.public_attribution_only: Owner pseudonyms are retained as content attribution; no user profiles or private/member data requested.

coverage_and_languages.summary: Ten current examples span five observed languages, including four used in India. This verifies a bounded language-example route, not full courses or geographic availability.

facts.geography: Operator France; one managed cloud vantage, physical country unverified. Hindi/Tamil/Marathi/Bengali coverage does not prove India network availability.
facts.audience: Terms say services are not intended for children under13. Do not add C01 or claim child suitability.

query_contract.summary: Official specification exposes public no-auth stable /v1/sentences search and /v1/sentences/{id}. Five native-language topics and five distinct known-ID lookups pass.

facts.filters: Language required; sort=relevance, limit3, is_unapproved=no, is_orphan=no, showtrans=none. No audio or translation expansion.
facts.paging: Cursor response omits total after first page; parser accepts unknown total, preserves first/next links and validates same origin. Two pages have six distinct IDs.
facts.missing_native: HTTP404 JSON; not empty valid sentence.
facts.documentation_contradiction: One OpenAPI returned-translations table calls trans:is_direct=yes indirect. Translation filtering is untested/outside this adapter; preserve contradiction before later expansion.
facts.deprecated: Migration guide marks APIv0 deprecated; stable v1 is used.

rights_and_cost.summary: Every tested sentence explicitly labels CC BY2.0FR; the corpus also documents some CC0 text. Audio rights are independent and may prohibit external reuse. Attribution guidance differs in detail.

facts.text_reuse: Terms6.2/6.5 require author attribution and license; FAQ says credit Tatoeba with its link/license. Both primary statements retained.
facts.attribution_record: Save native URL, owner pseudonym, license and Tatoeba origin; two native logs show original contributor/date. Current owner is not assumed to establish complete authorship/edit history for every item.
facts.metadata_and_text: Public read-only supported API supplies the complete short text and associated metadata. No separate metadata license inferred beyond documented corpus reuse terms.
facts.audio: Blank audio license means no reuse outside Tatoeba; NC/ND/SA exceptions exist. No audio downloaded/played.
facts.cost: No key/account/payment used. No numeric quota or unlimited-use claim.

open_questions: Reconcile FAQ simplified attribution with terms/original-author history for retained records; preserve both requirements.

reader_access.summary: Anonymous Hindi desktop and Tamil mobile pages render the exact native sentence IDs/text, with translations visibly separated; no horizontal overflow or page errors in these samples.

facts.mobile_metadata: Metadata is behind an untested button; do not claim mobile license panel interaction verified.
facts.static_template_warning: Unrendered HTML includes a generic This sentence is not reliable template. It is not visible after rendering, consistent with API is_unapproved=false; do not classify template text as an actual item warning.
facts.historical_logs: Hindi record added2024-08-04 from Santali sentence12625904; Tamil record added2015-06-11 from English887131. Snapshot dates are not creation dates.
facts.translation_scope: Provider UI displays direct translations separately from translations of translations; incidental UI text is not independently qualified translated content.

open_questions: Complete keyboard/screen-reader review and mobile metadata/license interaction; no main landmark present.
Validate additional native-reader destinations without audio or contributor-profile collection.

quality_and_relevance.summary: Native-script queries return actual example sentences; keyword sense, morphology and content suitability require independent review.

facts.english_ambiguity: book matches Read books and Book now; second is reservation sense, not a book item.
facts.tamil_morphology: புத்தகம் returns inflected புத்தகங்கள் and புத்தகத்தைக் rather than an exact codepoint substring; these remain related language examples.
facts.indic_examples: Hindi पानी, Marathi पुस्तक, Bengali বই preserve native scripts/IDs. No verified pedagogical level or translation correctness inferred.
facts.negative_suitability: Second English page includes native13054920 with profanity despite is_unapproved=false and non-orphan filter. Not-unapproved does not mean proofread, age-appropriate or instructional.
facts.provider_warning: Corpus-use page says reviews/native-skill labels do not guarantee correctness and recommends personal proofreading; terms do not guarantee translations/audio accuracy.

open_questions: Manual suitability/grammar and intent review across retained examples; no automated child-safe claim.
Test translation direction, native-script/transliteration distinctions and correction handling before expanding scope.

operating_limits.summary: Serial bounded no-auth queries use current policy evidence, exclusive lease, three-result cap and no automatic retries. Mutable content requires correction/removal-aware refresh.

facts.stable_api: v1 per captured specification; unstable endpoints excluded.
facts.refresh: Official use guidance recommends frequent correction updates; downloads index says Saturday06:30UTC exports. No export downloaded and export schedule is not API freshness guarantee.
facts.failure_preservation: Cursor parse failure retained with offline same-response reinterpretation;400/404 preserved.

open_questions: Rehearse revisions/deletions/license changes and outages with a maintained refresh workflow; obtain later-session reliability.

decision_and_followup.summary: Retain ten query examples for one scoped language-example catalog; full qualification and C14 closure remain open.

facts.next_action: Resolve text attribution guidance and owner/original-author history, review suitability and translation direction, complete accessibility and correction/removal refresh evidence. No audio download or profile harvest. Continue other zero-query areas; no activation.
facts.blocked_source_policy: No unchanged denied-provider retry; no accounts or outreach.

next_action: Resolve text attribution guidance and owner/original-author history, review suitability and translation direction, complete accessibility and correction/removal refresh evidence. No audio download or profile harvest. Continue other zero-query areas; no activation.
limitations: One corpus; five languages, sentence IDs, translations and downstream mirrors are not independent origins.
Text-only research subset; no audio, user profile lookup or corpus download.
Not a structured language course or automatic classroom/child-safety certification.
Current query response has no last-modified timestamp; sentence ID is mutable identity, not immutable edition.
